derivedFrom.decision: phase2-plan/cqrs/FINAL-CQRS-20261023.md and ADR-CQRS-06: lists read the source; projection maintenance off by default

abExclusions.decision: user 2026-10-22: exclude E-b rescue limiter from the measured AB source
abExclusions.reason: pinned stack strips env (RESCUE_REPORT_* cannot be set); PCN trace sends ~12.5k rescue reports/30 min from one IP over 100 tokens; O has no such limiter

sharedEnvironmentPatch.decision: user 2026-10-22 (K3v2-F2), kept from v3: same default per-IP read limit for O and AB

F_final.configurationF: AB source, CLINIC_READ_PROJECTION=off (product default), authoritative reader, no projector, no read diagnostics

configurations.O: Pinned pre-CQRS source with its original schema and required components; shared per-IP read limit patch (6000/min)
configurations.F: Final product: AB source at the CQRS decision with CLINIC_READ_PROJECTION=off (default), authoritative reader, no read-revision events, no projector, no read diagnostics; shared read limit patch

pcn.fixture: phase1-pcn-shape-v1: 100 owners/pets and one appointment, medical, hotel, invoice and notification per owner

acceptance.thresholdSource: every bound copied from the v3 acceptance; the query-heavy primary list uses the same 1.1 bound as the PCN list and the calendars
acceptance.grading: Every valid matched block separately (every pair within the bound); decision NO_REGRESSION only when both workloads are graded and every gate passes

generatorValidity.calibrationTarget: Local no-op/loopback outside application, with the planned concurrency, observer and resource collector running; never lower application arrival rate from calibration
generatorValidity.openLoopLatency: Both completion minus dispatch and completion minus scheduled; use scheduled end-to-end latency for acceptance, retain all failures/drops in outcome counts
generatorValidity.closedLoop: 100 active users throughout measured window, no ramp/warmup samples, raw per-user task/wait/start/completion, event-loop delay probe at 10Hz with the same 100ms p99/1000ms maximum; actual RPS is an outcome
generatorValidity.invalidRule: Do not grade latency/throughput from invalid scheduling, missing timestamps or population; preserve raw and report INVALID_ENVIRONMENT or INCONCLUSIVE

sessions.unit: One complete matched block in one notebook kernel; multiple blocks allowed if profile remains identical
sessions.replacementRule: Only objectively incomplete/invalid-environment blocks, never a valid slow/losing block; retain original and replacement, first valid complete block wins. A second environmental invalidity stops the study as incomplete. Correctness/application failures halt for diagnosis, not replacement.
sessions.profileMismatchRule: Keep separate strata; complete all three blocks under one comparable key for an acceptance. Never combine unmatched halves or choose a winning session.
sessions.accounting: All API/worker/PG-child/broker/Redis/gateway/audit CPU in measured window; generator/controller separately, root cgroup total separately; uncovered/unreadable process CPU means TOTAL_COST_INCONCLUSIVE
sessions.protectedData: Disposable owned trial DB/schema/marker/roles/queues only, correct schema per source. Never use main DB, mix V1/V2 consumers or run V1 binary on V2.

scope: Final product F against the pre-CQRS source O on the Kaggle shared envelope; includes every change since 3e88d7e, not only the CQRS switch
excludes: new freshness/recovery/rebuild drills if existing evidence does not match the build/profile

profile.buildDigest: path-normalized (tools/phase2/cqrs/activity/bench/profile.mjs); raw digest reported, not keyed
profile.poolCheck: observed pg_stat_activity peak per database role <= sum of ceilings of the processes sharing that role

accounting.measuredWindowObservation: no stack observe/inspect actions inside measured windows; only the pool sampler (one pg_stat_activity catalog query/s over the private socket) runs, identically for O/A/B; v2 adds the diagnostics sampler (one set of catalog/count queries every 5 s over the same socket), identically for O/A/B

readPath.queryHeavy: Q6 correct_path: O absent, F authoritative (no projection headers); anything else is a contract error
readPath.pcn: GET appointments: O absent, F authoritative; F has no projection and no fallback, anything else is a path error

freshnessRecovery: Not applicable: F maintains no read model
performanceMeasurementsAllowed: only after a readiness smoke in the same session records the profileKey and passes

diagnostics.sampler: benchmarks/phase2/kaggle/list_study_v2.py MemberDiagnostics, one thread per member, identical for O/A/B
queries: outbox pending count and oldest age per service DB (core, clinic)
files: postgres.log lines: checkpoint, automatic vacuum/analyze, ERROR/STATEMENT (SQL text only, parameters are placeholders)
Clinic API CLINIC_READ_DIAGNOSTIC lines (already sanitized by readDiagnostics.ts)
diagnostics.cost: catalog/count queries over the private admin socket every 5 s inside measured windows; counted under the postgres role; reported, not subtracted
diagnostics.grading: diagnostic only; never used for grading or replacement decisions

supersedes.reason: bundle v12 predated the Circuit Breaker and the Notification AQ-05 check on measured paths; replaced before any measurement

changesFromV3: Configurations O and F (final product) instead of O/A/B; blocks O,F / F,O / O,F
Gates: F/O non-regression with v3 bounds; no read-path improvement gates (the projection was rejected by K2v2)
Source bundle v13: AB = working tree after the CQRS decision, AQ-09, the Clinic->Core Circuit Breaker and the Notification AQ-05 check (minus E-b), same shared read-limit patch as v11
Harness overlay: F configuration added to cqrs_runtime.mjs, stack.mjs, native_stack.py, cqrs_probe.py; O/A/B unchanged
Member runner final_trial.py (list_trial.py unchanged, configurations O and F)
